original_text: <!-- (audio) Jake: In the morning, I have to check the security cameras to make sure they are working properly. I have to monitor the entrances and exits at all times. -->
translated_text: <!-- (audio) Jake: Ujutro, moram da proverim sigurnosne kamere kako bih se uverio da pravilno rade. Moram da nadziru ulaze i izlaze u svakom trenutku. -->
